decisions.reason: By 2022 this multi-model garage door operator line has had time to prove its fit with the firm's core system offering, so keeping it is the likely choice unless a replacement program is imminent.

The solid wood sectional garage door remains a narrower niche option, but in a customization-oriented German door maker it is still worth retaining as long as carrying costs stay modest and it supports the breadth of the portfolio.

This glazed industrial sectional door sits close to the firm's established industrial door business, and continued survival after launch suggests enough market acceptance to justify keeping it on the market.
